description: This PHP source file defines the HomePageDao class, which manages database operations related to retrieving home page and module default page records for user roles within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to fetch records in priority order based on role IDs, with filtering by module name and joining related entities.

classes.name: HomePageDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for providing methods to retrieve home page configurations and default page settings based on user roles and modules.

methods.name: getHomePagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a list of HomePage entities associated with specified user role IDs, ordered by priority and ID in descending order.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ModuleDefaultPage entities for a specified module and user role IDs, ordered by module name and priority in descending order.
